description: This file defines the interface 'LegacyCommandClient' in Java, which extends 'RequestResponseClient' and provides methods for sending commands to devices in the Eclipse Hono project. It includes methods for sending commands expecting responses, with optional content types and properties, as well as one-way commands with no response expected.

classes.name: LegacyCommandClient
classes.description: A client interface for accessing Hono's Command and Control API, scoped to a specific tenant and device, providing methods for sending commands and one-way commands.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends a command to a device and expects a BufferResult response, with optional data and content type.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends a command with specific content type, data, and additional properties, expecting a BufferResult response.

methods.name: sendOneWayCommand
methods.description: Sends a one-way command (no response expected) to a device with optional data and content type.

methods.name: sendOneWayCommand
methods.description: Sends a one-way command with specific content type, data, and additional properties, without expecting a response.
